newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani money market rates rise, seen falling.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani money market rates rise, seen falling.

text.p: Pakistani money market rates closed sharply up on Sunday owing to a State (central) Bank of Pakistan special open market operation that picked up some three billion rupees, dealers said.
They said rates were likely to fall on Monday on the maturity of another open market operation.
Initially, deals were struck between 9.00 and 11 percent but soon climbed to 17 percent as the news of the operation came in the market, one dealer at the Standard Chartered Bank said.
Some banks availed of the central bank's discounting facility, the dealer said. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
